newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Nat'l Rail seeks private interests.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Nat'l Rail seeks private interests.

text.p: The Australian National Railways Commission said on Thursday it was seeking private interest in a number of engineering and maintenance-based business enterprises connected with its rail network.

Australian National acting managing director Andrew Neal said in a statement the proposal could involve the eventual sale of the engineering businesses to the private sector or the establishment of joint ventures and strategic partnerships.

The federal government owned Australian National operates principally in South Australia and Tasmania, but its freight and passenger services include train movements to Perth, Alice Springs, Sydney and Melbourne, the statement said.

Neal said the expressions of interest call specificially affected engineering and maintenance workshops at Port Augusta and Islington, the Motive Power Centre and a one-stop wagon facility at Dry Creek in Adelaide, and various track maintenance facilities for lines throughout South Australia and elsewhere.
The sale proposal affected "above track" services only and the Commission would not be selling its ownership of the 7,000 km of rail track and corridor under its authority, Neal said.
